sloka: माहेश्वरे प्रवृत्ते तु यज्ञे पुम्भिः सुदुर्लभे ।वरांस्ते लब्धवान्पुत्रः साक्षात्पशुपतेरिह ।। ७.२५.९ ॥
transliteration: māheśvare pravṛtte tu yajñe pumbhiḥ sudurlabhe ।varāṁste labdhavānputraḥ sākṣātpaśupateriha ।। 7.25.9 ॥

translations.english: When the Maheswara sacrifice, which is very difficult for men to perform, was commenced, your son directly obtained boons from Pashupati (Lord Shiva) here.
